title: OpenTLV Corpus adapter capability descriptor, protocol version 1
description: The result of hello: who the adapter and the implementation are and what they claim to support. The harness sends only requests the descriptor covers, and still checks every answer. See docs/adapter-protocol.md.

protocol.description: The protocol version the adapter selected from the versions the harness offered.

supports.description: Combinations of standard edition, rules, operation, strictness and view the adapter executes. A request is supported when one entry covers all five.

provides.description: Capabilities registered in registry/registry.json that the implementation has, matched against the capabilities an assertion requires.

standard.description: Standard edition, as registered in registry/registry.json.

max_message_octets.description: Longest request line the adapter reads, excluding the line feed.

max_input_octets.description: Longest octets input the implementation accepts.

max_depth.description: Deepest nesting of TLV trees and typed values the implementation handles; a single primitive node has depth 1.
